name: march-compact-rules-v1
question: Do a passed-pawn term or bounded forcing search improve the compact evaluator on an untouched month?

selection.method: Seeded reservoir sample over the complete decompressed monthly stream.

development_data: Deduplicated union of human-transfer-v1 and transfer-confirmation-v1
duplicate_target_aggregation: Arithmetic mean of repeated shallow-Stockfish labels for the same rule-state hash.
confirmation_overlap_policy: Exclude every March rule-state hash present in the development union.
primary_tests: searched locked-3 minus static locked-3 forcing-stratum MAE
advance_rule: Paired mean improvement with a 95% source-game bootstrap interval excluding zero.
